rules: NEVER use Inter, Roboto, or standard sans-serifs for headings.
Apply tracking-tight to all headings above 32px.
Use font-medium or font-light for headings to keep the vibe human and sophisticated, not aggressive.
typography.installation: Ensure fonts are imported via Google Fonts in index.css or App.css.

rules: Avoid pure black (#000000); use deep pine (#1C2A24) instead.
NEVER use purple gradients or generic 'SaaS Blue'.
For backgrounds under text, ensure contrast ratio meets WCAG AA (min 4.5:1).
DO NOT use transparent backgrounds for dropdowns, headers, or overlays where content sits underneath.

public_client_experience.description: Warm, human, 'older sibling' tone. Marketing/directory pages.
public_client_experience.spacing: Generous spacing (p-12, py-20, gap-8). Let the content breathe.
public_client_experience.hero_section: Asymmetrical layout. Soft, overlapping imagery. Organic shapes. Hero image overlay max bg-black/30.
public_client_experience.therapist_directory: Sidebar filters (Specialty, Language, Price MYR). Grid of therapist profile cards (rounded-2xl, 1px border, soft shadow on hover).
public_client_experience.comparison_tool: Side-by-side grid (up to 3). Keep layout clean, highlighting key diffs like Price and Approach.
public_client_experience.quiz_flow: Step-by-step form with soft transitions. Focus on one question at a time to reduce cognitive load.

therapist_portal.description: Professional practice-management dashboard. Structured and dense but inherits the warm brand colors.
therapist_portal.spacing: Compact but clear (p-4 to p-6, tight gaps).
therapist_portal.dashboard_grid: Use Mode B: High Density Grid. 1px solid borders (#E2CBA3), flat surfaces, NO glassmorphism.
therapist_portal.components: Shadcn/UI components (tables for clients, tabs, simple charts/caps).
therapist_portal.monetization: Clear indicator of '5-client cap' for free tier. Subscription upgrade page uses clear pricing cards with primary CTAs.

components.strategy: Hybrid Approach. Use raw HTML/Tailwind for expressive public pages. Use customized Shadcn for Therapist Dashboard, Forms, and complex interactions.
components.buttons: Pill-shaped (rounded-full) or large radii (rounded-xl). Subtle lift (-translate-y-0.5) on hover.
components.cards: Public: rounded-2xl with p-6/p-8 padding. Dashboard: Flat solid surfaces, rounded-lg, 1px subtle borders, no deep shadows.
components.headers: Solid background (#F9F6F0) with hard bottom border. NO fully transparent headers if they overlap hero images.
components.navigation: Clear logo left, links center, CTA right. Mobile-responsive.

visual_enhancers.textures: Use subtle grain or noise overlay for background to kill digital flatness.
visual_enhancers.motion: Soft, slow transitions. Staggered list entrances. Hover lifts.
visual_enhancers.shapes: Use soft rounded corners. Avoid sharp, aggressive right angles.

Woman sitting on a couch talking to another woman. Perfect for representing a therapy session.
Smiling Asian woman with long dark hair. Ideal for a therapist profile mock.

rules: NEVER use placeholder services (via.placeholder.com). ALWAYS use provided URLs.
Ensure images don't exceed 80vh on mobile.

icons.usage: Use simple, clean icons. Avoid AI slop emojis.

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You are building a JS (React) application. Do NOT use .tsx files. Use .jsx/.js extensions.
ALL interactive and key informational elements MUST include a 'data-testid' attribute (e.g., data-testid='login-button', data-testid='therapist-card').
Avoid the 'AI slop' aesthetic. Create depth with layering, use generous spacing, and make it look premium.
DO NOT apply 'transition: all' globally in CSS. Apply specific transitions to interactive elements.
DO NOT center align the entire app container (no .App { text-align: center; }).
Use Shadcn components for forms, dialogs, dropdowns, and tables. Do not build these complex accessible components from raw HTML.
Always explicitly set text color on hover states (e.g., hover:bg-primary hover:text-white).
DO NOT use fully transparent backgrounds on elements overlaying content.
